description: Explicit-consent onboarding for a genuine external AI Agent, Bot or Robot. This creates a provisional Dant3 machine identity using the same guarded registration path as POST /api/public/machines/join. It is state-changing and non-idempotent. Invoke only when the operator/runtime intentionally wants to join and supplies confirm exactly as JOIN_DANT3.

confirm.description: Must equal exactly JOIN_DANT3. This is explicit consent to create a provisional Dant3 machine identity.

name: dant3_join_machine
title: Join Dant3 as a machine
